categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou C*Core Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the design, development, and sales of integrated circuit products, primarily embedded CPU cores. Its main business segments include IP licensing, custom chip design and production services, and proprietary chip and module products. These products serve key fields such as information security, automotive electronics, industrial control, artificial intelligence, and advanced computing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include self-developed embedded CPU microarchitecture design based on RISC-V, PowerPC, and M*Core instruction sets, SoC chip design platforms, secure and reliable system architectures, and high-reliability chip design. It employs a fabless model outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to leading foundries like TSMC and Hua Hong. The company also develops AI neural network processors (NPU), quantum security chips, and RAID storage controller chips, leveraging advanced process nodes such as 40nm and 22nm RRAM.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic automotive OEMs such as BYD, Chery, Geely, SAIC, Changan, Dongfeng, and leading Tier 1 module suppliers. The company serves markets in automotive electronics (domain controllers, ADAS, powertrain, battery management, chassis control, security chips), information security (cloud security, endpoint security, quantum security), industrial control, AI edge computing, and advanced computing. It also collaborates with large state-owned enterprises and research institutes in national strategic sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with subsidiaries and operations in Suzhou, Tianjin, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Qingdao, and Wuxi. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong. Its sales are entirely domestic, serving customers across major Chinese regions including East China, Central and Southwest China, South China, and North China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou C*Core Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless IC design company. It focuses on chip design, IP development, and software integration, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to external foundries and subcontractors. The company maintains close coordination with upstream wafer foundries and downstream module manufacturers and OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include advancing open-source RISC-V instruction set CPU technology, expanding automotive electronics chip portfolios, quantum security chips, and AI MCU chips. It emphasizes high R&D investment to enhance CPU microarchitecture, AI neural network processors, quantum-safe cryptography, and high-reliability automotive-grade chips. The firm also focuses on integrating AI and quantum technologies into existing product lines and expanding custom chip design services, especially in AI and advanced computing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of proprietary chips and modules, custom chip design and volume production services, and IP licensing fees. The company’s sales are mainly direct to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, with a smaller portion through distributors. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products or services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global semiconductor firms such as NXP, Infineon, STMicroelectronics, Bosch, ADI in automotive electronics, and ARM and SiFive in embedded CPU IP. It positions itself as a leading domestic supplier in automotive-grade MCU, DSP, mixed-signal chips, and security chips, focusing on replacing foreign products and meeting national strategic demands. It holds a strong position in China’s emerging RISC-V and PowerPC-based embedded CPU markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 574 million, a 27.78% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in proprietary chip/module sales and custom chip services. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -180.59 million, slightly wider than the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 3.2 billion, with net assets of RMB 2.19 billion. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with R&D expenses accounting for 56.26% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented but currently unprofitable profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou C*Core Technology emphasizes its fully自主可控 (independent and controllable) embedded CPU cores based on open-source RISC-V and PowerPC architectures, enabling domestic substitution of foreign chips. It offers a broad and customizable CPU IP portfolio, high-performance automotive-grade chips with functional safety and security certifications, and integrated AI and quantum security solutions. The company’s fabless model and strong R&D capabilities allow rapid innovation and tailored solutions for critical national and market demands, differentiating it in the Chinese semiconductor ecosystem.
